sessions.phase_label: CRM and lead-data integration planning and setup
Outreach tooling, campaign domain, and email setup

requirements.title: HubSpot CRM Setup
requirements.definition: Configure the project's HubSpot CRM account and applicable service plan for CRM use.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers base HubSpot account configuration only; lead structures, integrations, status synchronization, and reporting are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Sales Navigator Lead List Setup
requirements.definition: Create and configure lead lists in LinkedIn Sales Navigator for use as the pipeline's source data.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source-list configuration, not transfer, enrichment, or duplicate detection.

requirements.title: Apollo Account Setup
requirements.definition: Configure Apollo for use in lead capture, enrichment, and CRM integration.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Apollo configuration as a deliverable; the behavior of the resulting data pipeline is annotated separately.

requirements.title: LinkedIn CRM Membership Visibility
requirements.definition: Allow a user viewing a LinkedIn profile to determine whether that person is already represented in the CRM.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the independently visible duplicate-check behavior, not the later export or enrichment process.

requirements.title: LinkedIn Profile URL in CRM
requirements.definition: Store a normal LinkedIn profile URL for exported contacts in HubSpot rather than only a Sales Navigator URL.
requirements.boundary_note: The profile-link output can be correct or incorrect independently of whether the contact transfer itself succeeds.

requirements.title: Apollo Contact Email Enrichment
requirements.definition: Use Apollo to discover missing contact email addresses and automatically synchronize discovered addresses into HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers successful email discovery and synchronization; importing contacts for which no email can be found is a separate fallback behavior.

requirements.title: No-Email Contact Import Fallback
requirements.definition: Allow contacts whose email cannot be discovered by Apollo to be exported and added to HubSpot through a low-effort fallback process.
requirements.boundary_note: This fallback has a separate success criterion from automated enrichment and can be used when enrichment fails.

requirements.title: CRM Lead Classification
requirements.definition: Classify leads in HubSpot using appropriate custom properties, tags, categories, and lifecycle stages.
requirements.boundary_note: Classification fields and stages form one coupled data model; list management, nurturing, and notes/tasks are separate operational behaviors.

requirements.title: CRM Lead List Management
requirements.definition: Create and maintain CRM lists for lead groups such as silent, dead, campaign, or follow-up leads.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers list organization inside the CRM, not the transfer of a selected list to MeetAlfred.

requirements.title: CRM Lead Nurturing Workflow
requirements.definition: Provide a CRM-based lead nurturing process tied to the defined lead stages and categories.
requirements.boundary_note: Nurturing workflow behavior can evolve independently from classification fields, list storage, and follow-up campaign transfer.

requirements.title: CRM Lead Notes and Tasks
requirements.definition: Support notes and task assignment for leads in HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: Notes and task assignment are operational record-management functions, not attributes of lead classification.

requirements.title: Lead Communication History in HubSpot
requirements.definition: Expose relevant email and LinkedIn conversation history for leads inside HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: Communication content history is distinct from the summarized Lead Status value.

requirements.title: Silent-Lead Follow-Up Automation
requirements.definition: Move silent leads from prior CRM lists into a follow-up list and make that list available for a new MeetAlfred campaign without manually cleaning the former campaigns.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the business workflow for recycling silent leads; generic HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization is a separate mechanism.

requirements.title: HubSpot Funnel Reporting by Contact Source
requirements.definition: Provide HubSpot reporting that groups contacts by Contact Source, shows stage counts for each source, and supports visibility into contact-to-lead conversion.
requirements.boundary_note: Contact Source, stage distribution, and conversion are dimensions of the requested funnel report rather than unrelated reporting Requirements.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Account Setup
requirements.definition: Configure MeetAlfred with a plan that supports the required campaign integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers base account and plan configuration; campaign creation and lead synchronization are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Zapier Account Setup
requirements.definition: Configure a Zapier Pro account without unnecessary add-ons for the required integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the Zapier account configuration artifact, not the behavior of any individual Zap.

requirements.title: HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred Lead List Synchronization
requirements.definition: Automatically push leads from a selected HubSpot list into the selected MeetAlfred campaign through Zapier.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers transfer of leads after a source list and destination campaign exist; creating a new MeetAlfred campaign and Zap is independently actionable.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Campaign Creation Workflow
requirements.definition: Support creation of a new MeetAlfred campaign for a HubSpot list by creating the campaign and configuring or duplicating the corresponding Zap.
requirements.boundary_note: Campaign provisioning is separate from whether leads subsequently synchronize into the configured campaign.

requirements.title: Automated LinkedIn Campaigns
requirements.definition: Configure and operate automated LinkedIn outreach campaigns through MeetAlfred unless a client-approved alternative is selected.
requirements.boundary_note: LinkedIn campaign execution can be modified independently of email campaign execution and of the campaign script content.

requirements.title: Automated Email Campaigns
requirements.definition: Configure automated email outreach campaigns through MeetAlfred.
requirements.boundary_note: Email campaign automation is independently configurable and testable from LinkedIn campaign automation and email-account integration.

requirements.title: Preserve Existing MeetAlfred Campaigns
requirements.definition: Perform integration work without deleting or removing the client's existing MeetAlfred campaigns.
requirements.boundary_note: Protecting campaign configuration is separate from protecting genuine leads from test activity.

requirements.title: Production Lead Test Isolation
requirements.definition: Use mock or dedicated test leads for integration testing and do not use genuine client leads as test data.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete data-safety constraint on testing, not a generic testing or QA Requirement.

requirements.title: Campaign Message Isolation
requirements.definition: Prevent contacts retained from an old campaign from receiving that campaign's obsolete messages when new campaign work is performed.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns which messages existing contacts receive, not whether new leads are imported into a campaign.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Setup
requirements.definition: Acquire and configure a separate domain for outbound campaign use.
requirements.boundary_note: Domain acquisition and registrar choice are attributes of this setup obligation; mailbox creation, warming, and web forwarding are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Email Account
requirements.definition: Create an email account on the campaign domain for use in outbound campaigns.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers mailbox provisioning and provider compatibility, not warming or application integration.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain and Email Warm-Up
requirements.definition: Warm the newly created campaign domain and mailbox using an appropriate warm-up service before campaign use.
requirements.boundary_note: Warm-up is a bounded operational deliverable with its own defer/resume trajectory, separate from creating the domain or mailbox.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Web Forwarding
requirements.definition: Forward web visits for the campaign-related domain to the company's intended website.
requirements.boundary_note: Web forwarding is independently testable from email delivery and domain warm-up; the exact source and destination domain wording requires confirmation.

requirements.title: Campaign Email Integration with HubSpot
requirements.definition: Connect the campaign email account to HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: HubSpot email integration can fail or change independently from the MeetAlfred email integration.

requirements.title: Campaign Email Integration with MeetAlfred
requirements.definition: Connect the campaign email account to MeetAlfred for email outreach.
requirements.boundary_note: MeetAlfred email integration is independently actionable from HubSpot email integration and campaign creation.

requirements.title: Timed Multichannel Campaign Scripts
requirements.definition: Prepare outbound campaign scripts and timed sequences spanning LinkedIn and email interactions.
requirements.boundary_note: Script content and timing are a separate deliverable from configuring the automation that executes a campaign.

requirements.title: Outbound Lead Tracking in CRM
requirements.definition: Ensure leads generated through future outbound activity are transferred into and tracked in the CRM.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers retention of future outbound leads in CRM; the proposed Google Sheets transfer method is an implementation option rather than a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Parallel Outreach Accounts
requirements.definition: Support at least two outreach accounts operating simultaneously for future campaign work.
requirements.boundary_note: The required concurrency is established separately from the unresolved choice between alias and client-owned account identities.

requirements.title: LinkedIn-to-Apollo Contact Export
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Apollo-to-HubSpot Contact Synchronization
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Reply Status in HubSpot
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: LinkedIn Connection Status in HubSpot
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

unresolved_candidates.description: The history changes the LinkedIn-to-CRM integration topology several times; Event extraction must distinguish the client-accepted Apollo-mediated flow from unaccepted LinkMatch and optional Sales Navigator Advanced Plus proposals.
The domain-forwarding request repeats the same displayed domain as both source and destination, so the intended forwarding endpoints cannot be safely determined.
Timed multichannel scripts are discussed as possible follow-on work, but it is unclear whether they became part of the active contracted scope.
Paid LinkedIn advertising is proposed conditionally and questioned by the client, but no authoritative decision establishes it as a Requirement.
The client prefers automated MeetAlfred outbound activity while the freelancer recommends manual conversations; the final operating model remains unresolved.
Multiple simultaneous outreach accounts are requested, but the identities and ownership model for those accounts remain unresolved.
